selection.rule: A_MAIN pooled wins/attempts in [0.75,0.90]; nearest 0.80; then nearest 0.92; then smaller ratio

caveat: 75–90% is an aggregate point target for fixed A_MAIN N3–5, not every cell or confidence interval. Mirrors, cross-ratio outcomes and repetitions are dependent. C_DIRECTIONS and D_DEFAULTS are separate diagnostics. Role exposure is not isolated causal role strength. Service routes and historical compatibility are tested separately.
